name: MonarchCopyField
title: CopyField
summary: A read-only value in an outlined field with a copy button, for links, records, keys and snippets.
whenToUse: For a value people copy into another tool: a webhook URL, a DNS record, an API key, an embed snippet, a calendar feed link.
whenNotToUse: For a short value inside running text, use MonarchCopyButton beside it. For a value people edit, use MonarchTextField. To send a link to another app, use the Sharesheet.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCopyField(value: String, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, multiline: Boolean = false, monospace: Boolean = true, sensitive: Boolean = false, showConfirmation: Boolean = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU, resetAfterMillis: Long = 2000L, helperText: String? = null, copyIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, copiedIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onCopy: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, copyLabel: String? = null, copiedLabel: String? = null, copiedAnnouncement: String? = null)

options.name: value
options.description: The read-only value shown and copied.

options.name: label
options.description: What the value is: the field's floating label and the end of the copy button's spoken name ("Copy Webhook URL").

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the field and its button.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the value can be copied; a disabled field uses the disabled colors.

options.name: multiline
options.description: Shows the whole value on several lines.

options.name: monospace
options.description: Shows the value in the code style.

options.name: sensitive
options.description: Marks the clip as sensitive, so Android 13 and later hide it in the clipboard preview.

options.name: showConfirmation
options.description: Shows the copied state on the button; by default only below Android 13, where the system shows no confirmation.

options.name: resetAfterMillis
options.description: How long the copied state lasts. Zero keeps it.

options.name: copyIcon
options.description: A copy icon. Given, the button is an icon button inside the field at the end; otherwise a text button beside the field.

options.name: copiedIcon
options.description: The icon of the copied state, such as a check mark.

options.name: onCopy
options.description: Called with the copied text after each copy.

options.name: copiedAnnouncement
options.description: Replaces the built-in state "Copied to clipboard" (monarch_copybutton_copied_announcement).

options.name: labelVisible
options.description: Whether the label shows above the field. False keeps it as the spoken name only.

states.name: idle
states.description: The value in the field and the button "Copy".

states.name: copied
states.description: For resetAfterMillis the button's state is "Copied to clipboard"; with showConfirmation its label reads "Copied" and copiedIcon replaces the icon.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field and the button use the disabled colors; the button does not copy.

appearance: The field has the MonarchTextField colors: the surface fill, the input border, the muted floating label and default text, or the subtle fill and disabled text when disabled. The text button is a secondary MonarchButton; the icon button uses the default text color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Built on OutlinedTextField directly, with MonarchTextField's colors, because MonarchTextField has no text style option and the value is shown in the code style by default. The web selects the value on focus and selects it again when the clipboard write fails; writing with the Android Clipboard does not report a failure, so there is no onCopyError, and the value can be selected by touch and hold in the read-only field. The web's rows option is not offered: a multi-line field shows the whole value, as on iOS. The web's size option is not offered: the field has the Material height of 56dp and the text button is the Lg MonarchButton next to it. The web's copyButtonProps pass-through is not offered. The web's iconOnly is copyIcon here, because Monarch bundles no icons; as on the web the icon button is still named "Copy" and the label. Android adds sensitive and showConfirmation from MonarchCopyButton.
accessibility: The field is a read-only text field: TalkBack reads the label and the whole value, and the value can be selected and copied by touch and hold.
The copy button is a separate element with a touch target of at least 48dp, named with the label: "Copy Webhook URL".
After a copy the button's state description is "Copied to clipboard" in a polite live region.
The text button follows the field in both layout directions and takes at most a third of the row, so a long label or a large font wraps it instead of squeezing the field.
edgeCases: A long single-line value scrolls inside the field; use multiline for certificates and snippets.
With helperText the button is centered on the field and its helper line together.
Below Android 13 the sensitive flag is written but ignored by the system.

examples.title: One-line values
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3)) {
    MonarchCopyField(
        value = {{fields.0.value}},
        label = {{fields.0.label}},
        labelVisible = false,
    )
    MonarchCopyField(
        value = {{fields.1.value}},
        label = {{fields.1.label}},
        size = MonarchFieldSize.Small,
        iconOnly = {{fields.1.iconOnly}},
        labelVisible = false,
    )
}
examples.code:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3)) {
    MonarchCopyField(
        value = "https://example.com/hooks/inbound/7f3a2c",
        label = "Webhook URL",
        labelVisible = false,
    )
    MonarchCopyField(
        value = "verify=c41e9b20d7",
        label = "TXT record",
        size = MonarchFieldSize.Small,
        iconOnly = true,
        labelVisible = false,
    )
}

examples.title: An API key with an icon button
examples.code:
MonarchCopyField(
    value = "sk_live_example_1234",
    label = "API key",
    sensitive = true,
    copyIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Copy, contentDescription = null) },
)

parityExceptions.reason: the web size sm is written as the enum entry MonarchFieldSize.Small (the web names sm | md | lg are Small | Medium | Large on Android)
